spell_selection.cc_interaction: All spells except Flash, Hexflash, Mark/Dash can be used under cast-inhibiting CC (excl. stasis, suppression). Flash/Hexflash also disabled while grounded or rooted.

spells.name: Flash
spells.full: Blink your champion a short distance forward or towards the target direction. Flash is disabled while you are unable to cast abilities.
spells.cast_restrictions: Cannot be used while grounded, rooted, or unable to cast abilities.
spells.when_to_choose: Almost every game on every champion; universal spell.
spells.why_to_choose: Best repositioning tool in the game; enables both aggressive and defensive plays.

hexflash.description: While Flash CD > 2s, replaced by Hexflash: channel up to 6.5s to blink 150-400 range.

patch_history.change: Bugfix: Fixed interaction with Jarvan IV combo airborne indicator.
New: Flashing during a skillshot dash now applies the dash's damage/effects at the flashed location.

spells.name: Ignite
spells.brief: Burn an enemy champion for true damage; applies Grievous Wounds and reveals.
spells.full: Ignite the target enemy champion for 5 seconds, revealing them, inflicting 60% Grievous Wounds, and dealing 72-380 (based on level) true damage over the duration. The first tick of damage occurs briefly after the cast, then subsequent ticks occur every 1.056 seconds.
spells.cast_restrictions: Can be used under CC (except stasis/suppression).
spells.when_to_choose: Need kill pressure in lane; enemy has high healing.
spells.why_to_choose: Best offensive summoner spell; 60% GW shuts down healing; true damage secures kills.

patch_history.change: Damage changed from 60-410 to 72-380. CD increased from 90s to 100s.
Grievous Wounds increased from 50% to 60%.
Target range increased from 550 to 600.
Target range reduced from 700 to 550.

spells.name: Heal
spells.brief: Heal yourself and the most wounded nearby ally; both gain movement speed.
spells.full: Heal for 110-400 (based on level) to you and the most wounded nearby ally champion, and both of you gain 30% bonus movement speed for 2 seconds. Champions affected by Heal within 35 seconds will receive 50% heal amount.
spells.cast_restrictions: Can be used under CC (except stasis/suppression).
interactions: Outgoing heals trigger Aery, Ardent Censer, Staff of Flowing Waters.
Reduced effectiveness if target was Healed within 35 seconds.
spells.when_to_choose: Duo lane (ADC or support); need shared sustain + MS escape.
spells.why_to_choose: Only spell that heals two champions + grants MS; core duo lane spell.

patch_history.change: CD reduced from 110s to 100s. Heal increased from 100-390 to 110-400. MS duration increased from 1s to 2s.
CD reduced from 130s to 110s. Heal increased from 90-370 to 100-390.
Reworked: Now heals both you and nearest wounded ally equally at 30% MS (was 200% on ally).
Effect increased to 200% on ally. Heal reduced. MS reduced from 30% to 20%. CD 120→130.

spells.name: Barrier
spells.brief: Shield yourself for a short duration.
spells.full: Shield your champion for 120-560 (based on level) for 2.5 seconds.
spells.cast_restrictions: Can be used under CC (except stasis/suppression).
interactions: Serpent's Fang reduces Barrier shield value.
Not reduced by Grievous Wounds (unlike Heal).
spells.when_to_choose: Facing burst assassins; mid lane 1v1 where Heal's ally component is wasted.
spells.why_to_choose: Larger effective self-HP than Heal in 1v1; not affected by Grievous Wounds; shorter effective commitment.

patch_history.change: Shield increased from 110-450 to 120-560. Duration increased from 2s to 2.5s.
CD reduced from 120s to 100s. Shield increased from 100-450 to 110-450.
Shield reduced from 115-465 to 100-450.
CD increased from 90s to 120s.

spells.name: Exhaust
spells.brief: Reduce a champion's damage and slow them.
spells.full: Exhaust the target enemy champion for 2.5 seconds, reducing their damage dealt by 40% and slowing them by 35% decaying over the duration.
spells.cast_restrictions: Can be used under CC (except stasis/suppression).
interactions: Slow and damage reduction are separate debuffs.
Cleanse removes both slow and damage reduction.
Slow stacks at diminished rate (highest applies fully, subsequent at 30% effectiveness).
spells.when_to_choose: Enemy has a fed assassin or burst diver; need to protect carry.
spells.why_to_choose: 40% damage reduction is the strongest single-target debuff in the game; shuts down divers.

patch_history.change: Range increased from 500 to 600. Slow reduced from 60% to 35%.
Range reduced from 700 to 500.
Slow changed from 20% flat to 60% decaying. CD reduced from 105s to 100s.

spells.name: Ghost
spells.brief: Burst of movement speed; extended on champion takedowns.
spells.full: Gain a burst of movement speed that decays to 25% bonus movement speed for 8 seconds. Scoring a champion takedown will extend the duration by 6 seconds and refresh the effects, up to the original duration.
spells.cast_restrictions: Can be used under CC (except stasis/suppression).
spells.when_to_choose: Need gap-closing on immobile bruisers/juggernauts; kiting with ranged champions.
spells.why_to_choose: Lowest CD summoner spell (90s); long sustained MS is better than Flash for some champions.

patch_history.change: Duration increased from 6s to 8s. Burst top speed reduced. Burst duration increased from 2s to 3s. New: On takedown, duration extended by 6s and burst reapplied.

spells.name: Cleanse
spells.brief: Remove all disables and grants brief CC immunity.
spells.full: Removes all disables (excluding Airborne, Nearsight, and Suppression) and summoner spell debuffs (excluding Mark) affecting your champion, and grants crowd control immunity for 0.25 seconds.
spells.cast_restrictions: Can be used under CC (except stasis/suppression). Self-cast only.
interactions: Removes Exhaust slow AND damage reduction.
Does NOT remove Airborne, Nearsight, or Suppression.
0.25s CC immunity window prevents immediate re-CC.
spells.when_to_choose: Enemy has critical single-target CC that will kill you (Ashe arrow, Lux binding, Ahri charm).
spells.why_to_choose: Only way to break CC without an item; life-saving vs pick compositions.

patch_history.change: CD increased from 100s to 110s. CC immunity duration reduced from 0.75s to 0.25s.
Added to Wild Rift.

spells.name: Smite
spells.brief: Deal true damage to monsters/minions; heals; upgrades to Chilling Smite after 3 uses.
spells.full: Deal 600 true damage to the target large or epic monster or minion and heal for 70 + (10% maximum health). Transforms into Chilling Smite after 3 uses.
spells.cast_restrictions: Required for jungling. Can be used under CC (except stasis/suppression).

conservation.on_large_monster_kill: consume all stacks, gain 1 gold per stack
conservation.catchup_generation: 12 stacks per 5s (if team gold -10% AND personal gold -5% vs allies' avg)

spells.when_to_choose: Playing jungle role. Required — cannot jungle effectively without Smite.
spells.why_to_choose: Only spell that secures objectives (Dragon/Herald/Baron); provides jungle-specific passives.

patch_history.change: Bonus gold duration increased 7:30→11:00. AD decay removed. Conservation max 150→180. Chilling Smite damage 800→1000.
Bonus AD now decays. Bonus gold disabled after 7:30. Ability damage vs monsters 15%→30%.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.brief: Channel to blink to a target champion, ward, or turret (before 6:00).
spells.full: Active: After channeling for 3 seconds, remove any homestart or homeguard buff and blink to the target champion or ward. Your destination will be visibly marked. Passive - [0-6:00 elapse]: You can also target allied turrets.
spells.cast_restrictions: Can be used under CC (except stasis/suppression).
interactions: Incurs 35s cooldown when the game starts.
Cannot target turrets after 6:00 game time.
Destination is visibly marked to all players.
spells.when_to_choose: Split-push strategy; baron lane champions needing to join teamfights.
spells.why_to_choose: Only global repositioning spell; enables split-push + teamfight participation.

patch_history.change: CD reduced from 180s to 150s.
Added as summoner spell. Channel 3s. Blink to champion/ward. Passive: target turrets before 6:00. CD 180s. (Teleport Enchant removed same patch.)
